details:
1. Hand tracking:

For the index, my hands are always positioned in a weird way, it's not moving my fingers at all to the left or right, but when I'm just simply holding my hands normally, they look all lop sided.

Highly recommend if the new hand tracking kit comes out with vrchat with the index, that there is an option to turn it off and use the old one.

2. Menu interaction:

With the new update, TOUCHING the grip at all makes EVERY menu intractable. Meaning if you are trying to type a message, if you even touch without putting any pressure on the grip pads, you will move your menu all over the place.

3. Steamvr issues, happening in current release build and even worse in beta.

When I press the home button to open steamvr, my tracking becomes disabled on both my hands, and my hips. This has been an on-going issue with the latest release build, but the only tracker that seemed to get disabled was my hips. Now it's my hips AND hands. I would like to not lose tracking if i'm just tabbing into steamvr to check desktop or change music without the use of xsoverlay.

4. Current release and Beta on-going issue with personal mirrors.

This is just an on-going issue since personal mirrors have been released, but they are INCREDIBLY laggy. There are issues when if I have a personal mirror up, and I tab to steamvr, my entire headset locks up. When I turn the mirror off, then tab into steamvr, it works just fine. EXTREME FPS lag happens too when I'm in a croweded group of people and have personal mirror on, regardless of remote players is turned on or off (environmental settings are turned off by default). I use my personal mirror to interact with people who may come up behind me and interact with my avatar with head pats or messing with my avatar's hair. It seems only related to the personal mirror, and not the face mirror.

Sometimes the personal mirror even renders terrain or objects in worlds even when environment is turned off.
title: VRchat Open Beta 7/20/2024 - Hand tracking / Menu / Steamvr issues
